Akathisia is an inner restlessness that drives repetitive movement, and the
movement usually fails to relieve it. That failure is the part worth
explaining, and accounts pitched at the receptor do not on their own explain
it. I am building an active inference account alongside them, which asks
whether the disorder sits in how bodily prediction errors are turned into
action rather than in the motor system itself.

Aripiprazole is the pharmacological handle, since a D2 partial agonist does not
act on dopaminergic signalling the way an antagonist does. A concept note is in
preparation.
